text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Wh-What's the matter! I can't tell 
what's wrong if you're crying, talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sniff... Um, remember when we went out 
together the other day and bought matching 
tenugui hand towels?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that tenugui towel with the stylish 
pattern. That really was a fine piece of 
work.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was really helpful for wiping away 
my tears, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a crybaby that I used it so much 
it ended up completely worn out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though we finally got matching 
ones... W-Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's all? Heck, that's something to 
be grateful for!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tools are meant to be used, y'know. No 
point in locking 'em away like precious 
heirlooms.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Using a hand towel until it's worn to 
shreds— there's no greater honor for a 
towel than that. Thanks, Ticket-zo.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, today was your birthday, right? 
Let's go shopping together again, whaddya 
say?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-Inari-san... Thank you so soooo much—!
